title.t: A past client is going through a hard time

when.t: A check-in or other touch is due for a past client the authorized user has marked with a hard time (adverse event).

steps.t: Agent 16 sends nothing and logs the blocked touch with the reason.
Only the authorized user can set or clear the mark.
The mark is a signed setting the authorized user records; Agent 16 does not read it from messages.
Every touch from Agent 16 first checks, in order: on the authorized user's client list, not opted out, no hard time on record, contact not marked stale.

never.t: Contact someone during a hard time on a schedule.

you_see.t: The blocked touch in the client's history.

test.t: A deal closes October 20; the authorized user marks a hard time; the daily run on November 20 finds the 30-day check-in due.

when.t: The authorized user records that a past client opted out.

steps.t: From then on every touch from Agent 16 to that client is blocked and logged: check-ins, greetings, review and referral requests, rate alerts.
Only the authorized user can reinstate the client.
Agent 11 separately blocks any client message without consent on record (only the one opt-out confirmation is exempt).
The opt-out is a signed setting the authorized user records; Agent 16 does not read it from messages.

never.t: Send one more scheduled touch after an opt-out.

you_see.t: Blocked touches in the client's history.

test.t: Close October 20; the 30-day check-in goes on November 20; the client opts out; the 90-day check-in on January 19 and a review request are both blocked.

title.t: A past client mentions new business

when.t: A past client's reply reaching Agent 16 contains "thinking of selling", "looking to buy again", "want to list" or "ready to move".

steps.t: Agent 16 opens a new thread and sends it straight to Agent 02 as a new lead; it negotiates nothing.
The new lead skips Agent 01: no consent check and no duplicate check.
It carries no details, so Agent 02 cannot score it and asks the authorized user.

you_see.t: A question from Agent 02 that the new lead cannot be scored.

test.t: After a close, the past client writes "We're thinking of selling next spring, can we talk?".

title.t: A greeting is due for someone not on the client list

when.t: A date greeting is due for a client who is not on the authorized user's client list.

steps.t: Agent 16 sends nothing, logs it, and tells the authorized user the client is not on the list.
Dates come from Agent 14, where the authorized user records them; the daily run checks them.

never.t: Contact anyone not on the list.

you_see.t: A question saying the contact is not on the list.

test.t: A birthday of October 15 is recorded for T9, who is not on the client list; the daily run runs October 15.

title.t: A past client asks about a gift for referrals

when.t: A past client's reply reaching Agent 16 contains "gift card", "referral bonus", "pay you for" or "reward for referring".

steps.t: Agent 16 raises a legal-line alert with the message; nothing is sent to the client.
This check comes before the referral-reward check in 16-08.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert quoting the message.

test.t: "If I send my sister your way, do I get a gift card?"

title.t: An anniversary falls during a hard time

when.t: A purchase-anniversary greeting is due for a client marked with a hard time.

steps.t: Agent 16 sends nothing and logs the blocked greeting.
Nobody is alerted; the authorized user set the mark and decides when to clear it.

never.t: Send a celebration during a hard time.

you_see.t: The blocked greeting in the client's history.

test.t: Close October 20, 2026; anniversary recorded for October 20, 2027; a hard time is marked; the daily run runs October 20, 2027.

title.t: A past client asks about a new purchase

when.t: A past client's reply contains a new-business phrase.

steps.t: Agent 16 opens a new thread (the old name plus "-new") for the new lead; the closed one is not reopened.
As in 16-03, the new lead goes straight to Agent 02, which cannot score it and asks the authorized user.

you_see.t: A question from Agent 02 about the new lead.

test.t: "We're looking to buy again, a rental this time. Can you help?"

title.t: A past client mentions a referral reward

when.t: A past client's reply contains a referral-reward phrase such as "referral fee" or "finder's fee"; Agent 11 marks it.

steps.t: Agent 16 sends the client's words to Compliance (Agent 17) first.
No legal-line alert is raised for this phrase; the verdict goes to the authorized user (16-10).

never.t: Answer about a referral reward before Compliance has looked.

you_see.t: Compliance's verdict, to the authorized user.

test.t: "Is there a referral fee if my friend lists with you?"

title.t: A past client's contact details no longer work

when.t: The authorized user records that a past client's contact bounced.

steps.t: Agent 16 marks the client stale; every touch is blocked and logged.
Nothing looks for new details. Only the authorized user's signed reinstatement clears it.

you_see.t: The blocked touch in the client's history.

test.t: Close October 20; the contact is marked bounced; the daily run on November 20 finds the 30-day check-in due.

title.t: Compliance answers about a referral-reward mention

when.t: Compliance's verdict on a past client's referral-reward message arrives.

steps.t: Agent 16 sends the authorized user the verdict and findings; the reply to the client is the authorized user's. Nothing is sent to the client.

test.t: "Is there a referral fee if my friend lists with you?"
